- main:
  - text: INTENTGUARD BCH · LOCAL REQUEST DRAFT
  - heading "Make the payment request explicit." [level=1]
  - paragraph: Choose the network, recipient and exact amount before any wallet or transaction is involved.
  - link "Open the synthetic transaction inspector":
    - /url: /
  - complementary:
    - strong: No wallet, signature or payment.
    - text: This page checks request formatting and explicitly supplied offline planning data. A valid address does not prove who controls it or whether a merchant is trustworthy. Local review is not payment approval. Nothing is stored. The optional XO comparison sends these fields only to this computer’s loopback server; no wallet, node or external service is contacted.
  - heading "Try a complete synthetic example" [level=2]
  - paragraph: These buttons replace the request and funding fields together with invented data. They do not create coins, fetch a wallet or approve a payment.
  - button "Load full BCH example"
  - button "Load full token example"
  - heading "1. Create a request" [level=2]
  - paragraph: "Full CashAddr prefixes are required. Chipnet and other BCH test networks share the bchtest address prefix: the address alone cannot distinguish them."
  - text: Request reference
  - textbox "Request reference":
    - /placeholder: invoice-example-1
  - text: Network
  - combobox "Network":
    - option "Chipnet · test network" [selected]
    - option "Bitcoin Cash mainnet · draft only"
  - text: Asset
  - combobox "Asset":
    - option "BCH only" [selected]
    - option "Fungible CashToken"
  - text: Recipient CashAddr
  - textbox "Recipient CashAddr":
    - /placeholder: bchtest:…
  - text: BCH amount (includes token carrying BCH)
  - textbox "BCH amount (includes token carrying BCH)":
    - /placeholder: "0.00001000"
  - text: Maximum total transaction fee (satoshis)
  - textbox "Maximum total transaction fee (satoshis)": "600"
  - text: Expires within 24 hours (UTC, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ)
  - textbox "Expires within 24 hours (UTC, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ)":
    - /placeholder: 2026-11-05T12:00:00Z
  - button "Review draft"
  - button "Clear request"
  - heading "Or import an untrusted request" [level=2]
  - paragraph: Paste a previously exported request. It is revalidated using the current clock and never restores a prior confirmation.
  - text: Request JSON (maximum 8 KB)
  - textbox "Request JSON (maximum 8 KB)"
  - button "Import and review draft"
  - heading "2. Read every detail NO DRAFT" [level=2]
  - generic: No current draft. Review again after any edit.
  - paragraph: Not reviewed.
  - button "I have checked these request details locally" [disabled]
  - button "Download request JSON" [disabled]
  - paragraph: Downloaded request JSON intentionally contains the recipient address and payment terms. Keep it private unless you choose to share it. It contains no wallet secrets or proof of payment.
  - heading "3. Supply a separate offline funding context" [level=2]
  - paragraph: No funding context supplied. Nothing is fetched or inferred.
  - paragraph: For this form, select one output from one complete parent transaction. The owner address, unspent status, network and observation time are your unverified claims. No chain is contacted. Editing the request clears all funding fields and any prior plan.
  - text: Declared owner CashAddr
  - textbox "Declared owner CashAddr":
    - /placeholder: bchtest:…
  - text: Change CashAddr (same declared owner)
  - textbox "Change CashAddr (same declared owner)":
    - /placeholder: bchtest:…
  - text: Complete parent transaction hex (offline source, maximum 100 KB)
  - textbox "Complete parent transaction hex (offline source, maximum 100 KB)"
  - text: Selected output index
  - textbox "Selected output index":
    - /placeholder: "0"
  - text: Claimed observation time (UTC, valid for two minutes)
  - textbox "Claimed observation time (UTC, valid for two minutes)":
    - /placeholder: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ
  - text: Target fee rate (satoshis per 1000 bytes)
  - textbox "Target fee rate (satoshis per 1000 bytes)":
    - /placeholder: "1000"
  - text: Maximum fee rate (satoshis per 1000 bytes)
  - textbox "Maximum fee rate (satoshis per 1000 bytes)":
    - /placeholder: "3000"
  - text: Declared signature-size assumption
  - combobox "Declared signature-size assumption":
    - option "Choose a model" [selected]
    - option "Compressed P2PKH Schnorr"
    - option "Compressed P2PKH low-S ECDSA"
  - checkbox "Allow only a sub-dust BCH remainder to be added to the fee, within both fee limits"
  - text: Allow only a sub-dust BCH remainder to be added to the fee, within both fee limits
  - checkbox "I checked these supplied offline fields and understand that funds, ownership and unspent status are not verified"
  - text: I checked these supplied offline fields and understand that funds, ownership and unspent status are not verified
  - button "Build offline plan" [disabled]
  - button "Clear funding context"
  - heading "4. Inspect the exact plan NO PLAN" [level=2]:
    - text: 4. Inspect the exact plan
    - generic: NO PLAN
  - generic: No current offline plan. Review the request and supply the funding context.
  - generic "Technical offline plan details"
  - button "Download offline plan report" [disabled]
  - paragraph: Downloaded reports include scripts, token categories, amounts and content digests. Keep them private unless you choose to share them. Reports contain no signing authority, signatures, verified receipts or secret keys.
  - heading "5. Compare a real XO template candidate NOT COMPARED" [level=2]
  - paragraph: This optional step uses the pinned official XO engine and P2PKH template to independently compile the recipient and construct unsigned transaction bytes. It supports one BCH or fungible-token recipient. IntentGuard still supplies the explicit funding, change and fee budget. This is reference integration, not a new template, authenticated Invitation or executed contract.
  - paragraph: Clicking Compare sends the current request and offline funding fields to this local server only. It does not connect an XO account, generate keys or signatures, contact a node, or spend anything.
  - button "Compare with official XO template" [disabled]
  - button "Cancel comparison" [disabled]
  - button "Download XO comparison report" [disabled]
  - generic: No XO comparison. Build a current offline plan first.
  - generic "Technical XO comparison details"
  - paragraph: The report includes transaction summaries and content digests, not raw parent or unsigned transaction bytes. It is not an executable Invitation, signature approval, proof of ownership, or receipt.
  - generic: "Unsupported: recipient identity proof, wallet ownership, live network verification, automatic UTXO discovery, signing, broadcasting and receipts. The transaction inspector remains a separate synthetic demonstration. No request is automatically funded from a teaching wallet or promoted into an evidence journal."
